import pandas as pd
import matplotlib.pyplot as plt
import seaborn as sns
import numpy as np

# Load data
df = pd.read_csv('data/customer_segments.csv')

# Create a figure with multiple subplots for comprehensive customer segmentation analysis
fig = plt.figure(figsize=(16, 12))
gs = fig.add_gridspec(3, 3, hspace=0.3, wspace=0.3)

# Calculate total spending
df['TotalSpending'] = (df['MntWines'] + df['MntFruits'] + df['MntMeatProducts'] + 
                       df['MntFishProducts'] + df['MntSweetProducts'] + df['MntGoldProds'])

# Calculate age
df['Age'] = 2024 - df['Year_Birth']

# 1. Income vs Total Spending (colored by Education)
ax1 = fig.add_subplot(gs[0, :2])
education_colors = {'Graduation': '#1f77b4', 'PhD': '#ff7f0e', 'Master': '#2ca02c', 
                   'Basic': '#d62728', '2n Cycle': '#9467bd'}
for edu in df['Education'].unique():
    mask = df['Education'] == edu
    ax1.scatter(df[mask]['Income'], df[mask]['TotalSpending'], 
               alpha=0.5, s=30, label=edu, color=education_colors.get(edu, '#7f7f7f'))
ax1.set_xlabel('Income ($)', fontsize=11, fontweight='bold')
ax1.set_ylabel('Total Spending ($)', fontsize=11, fontweight='bold')
ax1.set_title('Income vs Total Spending by Education Level', fontsize=13, fontweight='bold')
ax1.legend(title='Education', fontsize=9)
ax1.grid(alpha=0.3)

# 2. Age Distribution
ax2 = fig.add_subplot(gs[0, 2])
ax2.hist(df['Age'], bins=25, color='#2ca02c', edgecolor='black', alpha=0.7)
ax2.set_xlabel('Age (years)', fontsize=11, fontweight='bold')
ax2.set_ylabel('Frequency', fontsize=11, fontweight='bold')
ax2.set_title('Age Distribution', fontsize=13, fontweight='bold')
ax2.grid(axis='y', alpha=0.3)

# 3. Spending by Category
ax3 = fig.add_subplot(gs[1, 0])
spending_categories = ['MntWines', 'MntFruits', 'MntMeatProducts', 
                      'MntFishProducts', 'MntSweetProducts', 'MntGoldProds']
category_totals = [df[cat].sum() for cat in spending_categories]
category_labels = ['Wines', 'Fruits', 'Meat', 'Fish', 'Sweets', 'Gold']
colors = ['#8B0000', '#FF6347', '#DC143C', '#4682B4', '#FFB6C1', '#FFD700']
ax3.pie(category_totals, labels=category_labels, autopct='%1.1f%%', colors=colors, startangle=90)
ax3.set_title('Spending Distribution by Product Category', fontsize=13, fontweight='bold')

# 4. Marital Status Distribution
ax4 = fig.add_subplot(gs[1, 1])
marital_counts = df['Marital_Status'].value_counts()
bars = ax4.bar(range(len(marital_counts)), marital_counts.values, color='#ff7f0e', edgecolor='black', alpha=0.7)
ax4.set_xticks(range(len(marital_counts)))
ax4.set_xticklabels(marital_counts.index, rotation=45, ha='right', fontsize=9)
ax4.set_ylabel('Count', fontsize=11, fontweight='bold')
ax4.set_title('Customer Marital Status', fontsize=13, fontweight='bold')
ax4.grid(axis='y', alpha=0.3)

# 5. Purchase Channel Distribution
ax5 = fig.add_subplot(gs[1, 2])
channel_data = {
    'Web': df['NumWebPurchases'].sum(),
    'Catalog': df['NumCatalogPurchases'].sum(),
    'Store': df['NumStorePurchases'].sum(),
    'Deals': df['NumDealsPurchases'].sum()
}
bars = ax5.barh(list(channel_data.keys()), list(channel_data.values()), 
                color=['#1f77b4', '#ff7f0e', '#2ca02c', '#d62728'], edgecolor='black', alpha=0.7)
ax5.set_xlabel('Total Purchases', fontsize=11, fontweight='bold')
ax5.set_title('Purchases by Channel', fontsize=13, fontweight='bold')
ax5.grid(axis='x', alpha=0.3)

# 6. Children vs Spending (boxplot)
ax6 = fig.add_subplot(gs[2, 0])
df['TotalChildren'] = df['Kidhome'] + df['Teenhome']
sns.boxplot(x='TotalChildren', y='TotalSpending', data=df, palette='Set2', ax=ax6)
ax6.set_xlabel('Number of Children', fontsize=11, fontweight='bold')
ax6.set_ylabel('Total Spending ($)', fontsize=11, fontweight='bold')
ax6.set_title('Spending vs Number of Children', fontsize=13, fontweight='bold')
ax6.grid(axis='y', alpha=0.3)

# 7. Campaign Response Rate
ax7 = fig.add_subplot(gs[2, 1])
campaigns = ['AcceptedCmp1', 'AcceptedCmp2', 'AcceptedCmp3', 'AcceptedCmp4', 'AcceptedCmp5', 'Response']
acceptance_rates = [df[camp].mean() * 100 for camp in campaigns]
campaign_labels = ['Cmp 1', 'Cmp 2', 'Cmp 3', 'Cmp 4', 'Cmp 5', 'Last Cmp']
bars = ax7.bar(campaign_labels, acceptance_rates, color='#9467bd', edgecolor='black', alpha=0.7)
ax7.set_ylabel('Acceptance Rate (%)', fontsize=11, fontweight='bold')
ax7.set_title('Campaign Response Rates', fontsize=13, fontweight='bold')
ax7.grid(axis='y', alpha=0.3)
ax7.tick_params(axis='x', rotation=45)

# 8. Recency vs Web Visits
ax8 = fig.add_subplot(gs[2, 2])
ax8.hexbin(df['Recency'], df['NumWebVisitsMonth'], gridsize=20, cmap='YlOrRd', mincnt=1)
ax8.set_xlabel('Recency (days since last purchase)', fontsize=11, fontweight='bold')
ax8.set_ylabel('Web Visits per Month', fontsize=11, fontweight='bold')
ax8.set_title('Recency vs Web Engagement', fontsize=13, fontweight='bold')

# Overall title
fig.suptitle('Customer Segmentation Dashboard - Comprehensive Analysis', 
             fontsize=16, fontweight='bold', y=0.995)

plt.savefig('output.png', bbox_inches='tight', dpi=150)
